product_one_liner.value: Mimica captures enterprise employees’ desktop activity, maps workflows, identifies process improvements, and generates AI agents to automate repetitive work for large enterprises and their transformation teams.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing or plans page was found; the website directs buyers to contact product experts.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 310 employees; June 2026 workforce data reports approximately 314.

eng_blog.notes: The Articles index contains product announcements, business guidance and company news; no qualifying pair of engineer-authored posts about building the product was found.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help-center link or multi-article product documentation portal was found; the public Articles and Guides are marketing resources, not a documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer.

model_provider.notes: No named underlying model/provider was verified in the product pages, security/privacy FAQ, blog or public subprocessor evidence. The disclosed Google Cloud Platform relationship is infrastructure, not an identified AI model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Company-stated compliance claims; GDPR and HIPAA are regulatory compliance claims rather than independently verified certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 24, 2025 round falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Mimica introduced Maker, an agentic automation platform, on September 30, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Hanyul Lee announced joining as VP of Sales on February 17, 2026.
